salesFloor.basis: The sum of Amazon's "bought in past month" badges over the top 10 organic results, each counted at the bottom of its bucket ("1K+" = 1,000), and that floor times their price. A floor, not an estimate of actual sales: a result without a badge counts 0, and every bucket can hide far more than its floor.

components.name: referral fee
components.note: Most categories; 8% to 17% in some (electronics, grocery and beauty under a price, clothing), 45% for Amazon device accessories; at least $0.30.

marketplaceFees.basis: Published list rates for US sellers, most categories. The FBA fulfilment fee depends on size and weight and is not in this figure: the Amazon Product Scraper works it out per product (its fees field).
